raw_text:
Michael Chen
DevOps Engineer

Contact Information:
Email: michael.chen@techmail.com
Phone: +1-555-0456
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/michaelchen-devops
GitHub: https://github.com/mchen-devops
Location: Seattle, WA

Professional Summary:
Experienced DevOps Engineer with 5+ years specializing in cloud infrastructure, automation, and CI/CD pipelines. Expert in AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, and monitoring solutions. Strong focus on reliability, scalability, and security.

Work Experience:

Senior DevOps Engineer | CloudScale Technologies
Seattle, WA | January 2022 - Present
- Architected and deployed Kubernetes clusters serving 100+ microservices
- Reduced infrastructure costs by 35% through AWS resource optimization
- Implemented infrastructure as code using Terraform managing 500+ resources
- Built comprehensive monitoring and alerting system using Prometheus and Grafana
- Achieved 99.99% uptime for critical production services
- Automated deployment processes reducing release time by 70%
- Tech Stack: AWS (EKS, EC2, RDS, S3), Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Jenkins, ArgoCD

DevOps Engineer | DataFlow Systems
Seattle, WA | March 2020 - December 2021
- Migrated legacy monolith to containerized microservices architecture
- Designed and implemented CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI and Jenkins
- Managed AWS infrastructure for applications handling 1M+ daily users
- Implemented security scanning in deployment pipeline (SAST, DAST, container scanning)
- Reduced deployment failures by 60% through automated testing and rollback mechanisms
- Tech Stack: AWS (EC2, ECS, Lambda), Docker, GitLab CI, Ansible, Python

Junior DevOps Engineer | TechStart Inc.
San Francisco, CA | June 2018 - February 2020
- Automated infrastructure provisioning using Ansible and CloudFormation
- Set up monitoring and logging solutions using ELK stack
- Managed Linux servers and implemented backup and disaster recovery procedures
- Created documentation for deployment processes and runbooks
- Tech Stack: AWS, Linux, Bash, Python, Ansible, CloudFormation

Education:

Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering
University of Washington | 2014-2018
GPA: 3.7/4.0

Technical Skills:
- Cloud Platforms: AWS (EC2, EKS, ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3, CloudFormation), GCP, Azure
- Container Orchestration: Kubernetes, Docker, Docker Swarm, ECS
- Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible
- CI/CD: Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, CircleCI
- Monitoring & Logging: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Datadog, CloudWatch
- Scripting: Bash, Python, PowerShell
- Version Control: Git, GitHub, GitLab
- Security: HashiCorp Vault, AWS IAM, Security Groups, Network Policies

Key Projects:

1. Multi-Region Kubernetes Platform (2023)
   - Designed and deployed multi-region Kubernetes infrastructure
   - Implemented disaster recovery with automatic failover
   - Technologies: AWS EKS, Terraform, ArgoCD, Prometheus
   - Result: Achieved 99.99% uptime across all regions

2. Automated CI/CD Pipeline (2022)
   - Built end-to-end automated deployment pipeline for 50+ microservices
   - Integrated security scanning, automated testing, and progressive delivery
   - Technologies: Jenkins, GitLab CI, SonarQube, Trivy, Kubernetes
   - Result: Reduced deployment time from 4 hours to 20 minutes

3. Infrastructure Cost Optimization (2023)
   - Analyzed and optimized AWS infrastructure spending
   - Implemented auto-scaling, reserved instances, and right-sizing
   - Technologies: AWS Cost Explorer, Terraform, CloudWatch
   - Result: Saved $120K annually in infrastructure costs

4. Observability Platform (2022)
   - Implemented comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing solution
   - Set up alerting and on-call rotation system
   - Technologies: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Jaeger, PagerDuty
   - Result: Reduced mean time to detection (MTTD) by 75%

Certifications:
- AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional (2024)
- Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) (2023)
- AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional (2022)
- HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (2022)

Achievements:
- Led incident response team, reducing MTTR from 2 hours to 30 minutes
- Published technical blog posts on DevOps best practices (10K+ reads)
- Contributed to open-source Kubernetes operators
- Mentored 3 junior engineers in DevOps practices
